objects.description:
[NIMBUS MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1059) has generated fictitious job-related themed websites that entice users to interact and launch malicious actions.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Feb2024)     

[NIMBUS MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1059) has also utilized decoy documents and files to provide a sense of legitimacy to the user.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Feb2024)     

[NIMBUS MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1059) has leveraged fake Microsoft Outlook login windows prompts to entice victims to enter their credentials.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549TTPsTools_Nov2025)
